description: I am a student building a web trainer for junior astronauts and trying to improve quick thinking.
summary:
This project is a fast-paced web game that is meant to try to train quick thinking and decision-making skills of young children and teens that aspire to be astronauts or have an interest in space. 
In the game, the player is a mysterious being that the astronauts cannot see or notice. The player can change the actions of the npcs by selecting the wrong thought and then correcting it.
details: It trains people that wanna be astronauts at a basic level. The intended impact is to strengthen quick thinking and decision-making. Used SI/AI for coding.
